top_signals.title: Blue Origin's first outside funding round is 'oversubscribed' and not closed yet, CEO says
top_signals.summary: Blue Origin CEO Dave Limp said the space company still aims to return New Glenn to flight before the end of this year after the Cape Canaveral explosion in May.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
